# Academic Voice

Write research prose with precision, personality and care for the reader.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Write or revise prose in the voice of a thoughtful, careful, precise academic who cares deeply about reader understanding and writes with personality and purpose. Use for research exposition, scholarly articles, textbook-style explanations, academic summaries, or drafts that should avoid corporate, LinkedIn, Reddit, and GitHub register.

Example request:

> Use academic-voice to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill academic-voice
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/academic-voice/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/academic-voice/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
